author: Fixture Reporter B
content:
IonQ, Inc. (NYSE:IONQ) shares are trading higher on Wednesday. The company said its Superion 128 quantum computer will be the first quantum processing unit installed at NVIDIA’s Accelerated Quantum Research Center (NVAQC).

NVAQC is a facility focused on integrating quantum processors with accelerated computing.

Install Superion 128 At NVIDIA Quantum Research Center

The deployment will connect IonQ’s full-stack quantum systems with NVIDIA’s AI infrastructure to advance large-scale quantum computing.

Under the partnership, IonQ will install a Superion 128 system at NVAQC and connect it directly to an NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 system through NVIDIA NVQLink, with workloads managed by the open NVIDIA CUDA-Q platform.

Read Also: Rigetti Stock Rises as IonQ-NVIDIA Deal Lifts Quantum Computing Sector

The joint research will focus on hybrid software development, large-scale system prototyping and quantum-GPU co-design, with applications including portfolio optimization and risk modeling, materials science and computational chemistry for drug discovery.

Notably, IonQ launched its sixth-generation Superion platform on September 8, 2026. The Superion 128 is available to order, with first customer deliveries expected in 2027, while its NVAQC installation is also scheduled for next year.

Fault-Tolerant Quantum Computing Milestone

On Tuesday, the company disclosed a milestone in fault-tolerant quantum computing, with researchers developing and successfully testing.

The company stated it is the industry’s first end-to-end, real-time quantum error correction decoder running on a single standard, commercially available CPU.

IONQ Technical Outlook: Key Levels And Momentum

With the stock at $45.29, it’s trading 15.2% above its 20-day SMA ($39.07) and 14.7% above its 50-day SMA ($39.24), but still 4.5% below its 100-day SMA ($47.13) — a setup that often turns the mid-to-high $40s into a "prove it" zone.

Momentum looks more like consolidation than a breakout chase: RSI is 53.29, which signals the move isn’t especially stretched yet (RSI is a gauge of how overheated or oversold price action is). The bigger-picture trend is still trying to repair itself after the death cross in August (50-day SMA below the 200-day SMA), even though price is now back above the 200-day SMA ($43.78).

  • Key Resistance: $48.00 — a nearby round-number area that can act as a stall point as price approaches the 100-day SMA zone
  • Key Support: $37.00 — a prior buyer-defense area that sits well below current levels, leaving room for volatility if the premarket pop fades

IONQ Earnings Preview And Analyst Price Targets

Looking further out, the next major catalyst for the stock arrives with the November 4, 2026 (estimated) earnings report.

  • EPS Estimate: Loss of 72 cents (Down from a loss of 17 cents from the same quarter last year)
  • Revenue Estimate: $143.50 million (Up from $39.87 million from the same quarter last year)

Analyst Consensus & Recent Actions: The stock carries a Buy rating with an average price forecast of $67.75. Recent analyst moves include:

  • Wedbush: Outperform (Maintains Target to $75.00) (Sept. 22)
  • Mizuho: Outperform (Lowers Target to $52.00) (Sept. 9)
  • Rosenblatt: Buy (Maintains Target to $100.00) (Sept. 9)
